scope: Performance diagnostics only; probes do not establish native acceptance.
notes: Restored HTML and both engine reference PNG hashes exactly match historical c12. The recovered response-cache directory fingerprint differs; no fixture-change saving is credited.
Baseline acceptance attempt stopped at first Brave abnormal watchdog exit; both counts and failure are retained. Two separate cleanup diagnostics exit zero after capture counters are frozen.
Headless CSS probes use 24 distinct recovered stylesheet paths (7656 top-level rules); earlier summaries saying 37 sheets were inaccurate.
Host contention is high and concurrent build/probe jobs are recorded. Sample profiles provide diagnostics, not instruction acceptance.

Rejected candidates include raw deferred-source preprocessing, ordinary subject index, larger inline-cache capacity, absent-class has filter, external containing-block topology cache, retained rare-data sharing, and the initial atomic-inline candidates. Their observations remain here.

Additional rejected candidates: full atomic-inline geometry reuse (including intrinsic queries), and longhand reuse for root calculations/color schemes/clip rectangles. Ordinary token boxing is an additional measured parser candidate.

C13 native seven-pair cohort fails 20 percent with normal browser exits and unchanged pixels; full data is in github-vlang-instructions-20261108-20pct-c13.json. Resolved special-property computation and disjoint subject filters were measured and removed for insufficient/reversed gains. Borrowed layout scalar reads save about 71 million headless layout instructions with identical geometry. No regression tests executed.

C14 is a second complete failing seven-pair native cohort: max Vox 9133086489 / min Brave 11044140373, exact per-engine pixels, all browser exits zero, benchmark/guard exit one for gate failure. No regression suites have run. Additional candidates: repeat-input ~73M, layout scalars ~71M, font presence ~26M, internal line buffers ~24M, disjunctive masks ~42M in separate headless comparisons; these are not additive native acceptance credit. Borrowed size construction regressed and was removed.

Static per-candidate :has result memoization regressed and was removed. Global absent-attribute proof was exercised but had no median gain and was removed with its DOM history fields and lifecycle hooks. DOM scalar serialization median probe gain is 8295233 instructions with unchanged geometry. First current native generation was rejected because prepare_http_compat.py changed during source verification; no executable or performance acceptance resulted. A unique retry uses the same current source-proof policy. Disjunctive subject masks now activate only in trusted scope-built caches; manual public cache mutation preserves the ordinary path.

Review found boxed component headers could remain in transient storage or be mutated through shared syntax. Complex-value export now detaches all retained payload headers/vectors. Frozen native-candidate2 predates this correction; native-candidate4 contains it. Candidate3 failed V generation and supplies no performance result. Regression tests remain unrun.

C15 diagnostic and c16 retain complete seven-pair cohorts with exact references and normal browser exits. Both fail the 20-percent numerical gate. C16 corrected build has max Vox 9106689654, min Brave 11061084520, ratio 0.8233089293851631. All regression tests remain deferred. New text graph export has 3,343,848 median headless instructions saved; the per-pair observations remain recorded, not additive native acceptance credit.

Literal V-prod/O3/native-CPU/inline-3000 headless probe saves 492081653 median instructions versus its O2 headless control with exact geometry. Native c16 already uses O3/inline1500, so this is not a native predicted saving. Native candidate5 exceeded the 12-GiB sampled guard during full-LTO linking; candidate6 exceeded it during native code generation from the source-proven optimized LLVM module. Neither launched a cohort. Candidate7 retries code generation with machine outlining disabled. No regression tests executed. Review also made font-rule history sticky so last-face removal remains synchronized for every sheet owner; that later correction is absent from candidate7.

Relative closed-inline measurement extension rejected: paired savings -3,787,833, -2,152,469, +17,203,733 instructions; median candidate regresses 2,926,790. Generated-inline extension also removed: combined policy median 17,913,205 is no improvement over generated FLEX/GRID-only 19,569,137. These are no-assertion diagnostic workloads, not deferred regression tests.

c19 rejected experimental LLVM backend pipeline regresses (max 9,607,344,384/min 10,877,278,616). c20 fresh C/native CPU/outlining-disabled candidate also fails (max 9,290,744,836/min 11,035,100,242). All 28 captures exact with complete audits and normal browser exits. New deferred regression tests remain unrun. Source scalar intrinsic width cache is a new prototype after c20 sealing.

Scalar open-inline intrinsic width cache rejected: median saving only 672,770 instructions with two of three matched pairs regressing, so collection/key overhead supplies no useful gain. Source removed; probe retained as matching pre-compaction control with VOX_DISABLE_INLINE_INTRINSIC_WIDTH_REUSE=1.

Compact retained inline input representation: rare image and measurement-image payloads move to separately allocated immutable snapshots; actual live image validation unchanged. New inline input is 168 bytes. Three matched headless workload pairs save 39,182,412, 43,430,670 and 21,754,410 instructions (median totals 4,405,051,141 -> 4,369,907,193); all geometry e46d920e379fdc0e. Distinct binaries pinned: scalar-intrinsic-probe control with its proposed reuse disabled, compact-input-probe candidate. No regression tests run. Native candidate9 uses prior c16 compiler settings, not rejected c19/c20 tuning.

Static has-input stamps rejected after matched three-pair headless probe: control median 4,370,261,179 / candidate 4,376,040,548; two of three pairs regress. No acceptance credit. c22 compiled this prototype before rejection. First probe compile failed because concurrent timer-host header was incomplete; second compilation succeeded after the header fix. Regression tests remain deferred.

Mixed ASCII/unicode tokenizer input retains identical numeric tables, bypassing rune-iterator optional work only for ASCII runs in otherwise valid UTF-8 input. Parser control median 1,177,177,724 -> candidate 1,157,453,593 instructions across 28 stylesheet occurrences, all 7,660 rules; 19,724,131 saved. Linear rule-parent cache-clearing prototype saved only about 3M/parser workload and was removed; its small gain did not justify broader parenting changes. Regression tests remain deferred.

Inline closure reuse rejected: median 4,404,799,449 -> 4,399,966,746 instructions, only 4,832,703 saved, insufficient to justify bypassing/replacing repeated closure guards. Runtime guard exit0 and all geometry e46d920e379fdc0e; no regression tests. Size-only diagnostic reports StyleValue 304 bytes, RGBColorStyleValue 296, Shadow/RadialGradient 280, HSL/HWB/Conic 256; investigates a representation bottleneck, no performance credit yet.
